title: UTA-wave 1.1.7 Uninterrupted Background Playback & Doze Fix
changelog:
• Fixed screen-off background playback stopping after ~3 songs in Android Doze mode
• Added PlaybackWakeLockHelper with CPU transition lock and high-performance Wi-Fi lock
• Added proactive zero-gap next-track stream pre-resolution during active playback
• Integrated dynamic PlayerClient headers in ExoPlayer to prevent CDN 403 Forbidden disconnects
• Added 'Uninterrupted Screen-Off Playback' setting with 1-click battery optimization exemption
• Enabled auto-recovery retry on stream errors and auto-skip by default
